mapper.sql: id, user_id, employee_no, name, phone, email, avatar_url, employment_status, profile_completed, hire_date, leave_date, version, profile_version, phone_verified, email_verified, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by
mapper.select: SELECT FROM t_employee WHERE user_id = #{userId} FOR UPDATE

SELECT COUNT(*) FROM t_employee employee INNER JOIN t_employee_assignment assignment ON assignment.employee_id = employee.id AND assignment.assignment_type = 'PRIMARY' AND assignment.status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.active_primary_marker = 1 AND assignment.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR assignment.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) INNER JOIN t_organization_unit organization_unit ON organization_unit.id = assignment.organization_unit_id AND organization_unit.enabled = 1 AND organization_unit.migration_placeholder = 0 INNER JOIN t_position position ON position.id = assignment.position_id AND position.enabled = 1 AND position.code <> 'UNASSIGNED_POSITION' WHERE employee.user_id = #{userId} AND employee.employment_status = 'ACTIVE'
SELECT FROM t_employee WHERE phone=#{phone} AND (user_id IS NULL OR user_id<>#{userId})
SELECT FROM t_employee WHERE email=#{email} AND (user_id IS NULL OR user_id<>#{userId})
SELECT FROM t_employee ORDER BY employee_no ASC, id ASC

SELECT DISTINCT employee.id, employee.user_id, employee.employee_no, employee.name, employee.phone, employee.email, employee.avatar_url, employee.employment_status, employee.profile_completed, employee.hire_date, employee.leave_date, employee.version, employee.create_time, employee.create_by, employee.edit_time, employee.edit_by FROM t_employee employee INNER JOIN t_employee_assignment assignment ON assignment.employee_id = employee.id AND assignment.assignment_type = 'PRIMARY' AND assignment.status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.active_primary_marker = 1 AND assignment.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR assignment.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) WHERE assignment.organization_unit_id = #{organizationUnitId} ORDER BY employee.employee_no, employee.id

SELECT DISTINCT employee.user_id FROM t_employee employee INNER JOIN t_employee_assignment assignment ON assignment.employee_id = employee.id AND assignment.assignment_type = 'PRIMARY' AND assignment.status = 'ACTIVE' AND assignment.active_primary_marker = 1 AND assignment.effective_from <= #{effectiveAt} AND (assignment.effective_to IS NULL OR assignment.effective_to > #{effectiveAt}) INNER JOIN t_user user_account ON user_account.id = employee.user_id AND user_account.account_enabled = 1 AND user_account.account_no_locked = 1 WHERE assignment.organization_unit_id IN #{id} ORDER BY employee.user_id
mapper.insert: INSERT INTO t_employee (user_id, employee_no, name, phone, email, avatar_url, employment_status, profile_completed, hire_date, leave_date, version, profile_version, phone_verified, email_verified, create_time, create_by, edit_time, edit_by) VALUES (#{userId}, #{employeeNo}, #{name}, #{phone}, #{email}, #{avatarUrl}, #{employmentStatus}, #{profileCompleted}, #{hireDate}, #{leaveDate}, #{version}, #{profileVersion}, #{phoneVerified}, #{emailVerified}, #{createTime}, #{createBy}, #{editTime}, #{editBy})
mapper.update: UPDATE t_employee SET name = #{employee.name}, phone = #{employee.phone}, email = #{employee.email}, avatar_url = #{employee.avatarUrl}, profile_completed = #{employee.profileCompleted}, hire_date = #{employee.hireDate}, leave_date = #{employee.leaveDate}, version = version + 1, edit_time = #{employee.editTime}, edit_by = #{employee.editBy} WHERE id = #{employee.id} AND version = #{expectedVersion}

UPDATE t_employee SET employment_status = 'ACTIVE', hire_date = COALESCE(hire_date, #{activatedAt}), version = version + 1, edit_time = #{activatedAt}, edit_by = user_id WHERE user_id = #{userId} AND employment_status = 'PENDING'

UPDATE t_employee SET phone_verified = CASE WHEN #{channel} = 'PHONE' THEN 1 ELSE phone_verified END, email_verified = CASE WHEN #{channel} = 'EMAIL' THEN 1 ELSE email_verified END, profile_version = profile_version + 1, edit_time = #{verifiedAt}, edit_by = user_id WHERE id = #{employeeId} AND profile_version = #{expectedProfileVersion} AND employment_status IN ('PENDING','ACTIVE','HANDOVER') AND ((#{channel} = 'PHONE' AND phone IS NOT NULL) OR (#{channel} = 'EMAIL' AND email IS NOT NULL))
